title: upgrade-signature
description: The detached signature over a release manifest's exact bytes: ECDSA P-256 over the SHA-256 of the manifest, DER-encoded, made by the release key in the KMS. keyId names which of the agent's compiled-in keys made it (the SHA-256 of that key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo), so a second, future key can be added before it is used.

signature.description: Base64 of the DER-encoded ECDSA signature (at most 72 bytes).
